name: tecr-vscode
description: Token-Efficient Code Retrieval — VS Code chat participant powered by tecr-mcp

workspaceTrust.description: TECR spawns the tecr-mcp server as a child process to read your workspace.

chatParticipants.name: tecr
chatParticipants.description: Token-Efficient Code Retrieval — ask @tecr to map and navigate your codebase.

tecr.mcpServerPath.description: Override path to the TECR MCP server (absolute path to dist/index.js). Leave empty to use `tecr-mcp` from PATH after `npm install -g @tecr/mcp`.

tecr.contextWindow.description: Token budget passed to the TECR governor (TECR_CONTEXT_WINDOW env var).

tecr.localModelUrl.description: Base URL of a local OpenAI-compatible model for sub-agent offload, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (TECR_LOCAL_MODEL_URL env var).

tecr.telemetryEnabled.description: Enable per-turn telemetry emission to stderr. Disable to set TECR_NO_TELEMETRY=1.
